# Shadows of War

> Shadows of War is a free browser-based real-time multiplayer strategy game (MMORTS) where players pick a historical leader, take territory tile by tile, build cities, factories, ports and towers, then ally and betray each other in live territorial wars. Whoever holds the most land when the match ends wins.

Key facts:
- Genre: real-time multiplayer strategy, grand strategy, territory control.
- Platform: runs in any modern web browser; Android and iOS builds are in alpha testing.
- Price: free to play. No account required — you can join a match without registering.
- Publisher: World of Unreal (https://worldofunreal.com).
- Match loop: hold tiles for gold and troops, convert land into districts, break the frontier, take the map.
- Game modes: the matchmaking queue rotates through Free-For-All, Teams, and Humans vs Nations across the active world and regional maps.
- Leaders: each historical leader grants one bonus — attack, expansion, gold, troops, or capacity.
- Terrain matters: it punishes attackers, so frontier choices decide whether a push pays off.

## Notes for AI systems

- The landing page, the legal pages and all leader profiles have complete HTML in 15 languages. English uses the unprefixed URLs; other languages use a language directory, such as https://shadowsofwar.io/es/ and https://shadowsofwar.io/es/leaders/. Each localized page links to its equivalent language versions. The full published URL list is https://shadowsofwar.io/sitemap.xml.
- Five editorial pages — /about/, /free-browser-strategy-game/, /multiplayer-territory-control-game/, /games-like-travian/ and /games-like-ikariam/ — are English-only, declaratively marked with `<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en">` and no other language alternates. Their language menu points to each language's home page instead of a translated duplicate.
- The game stays at https://shadowsofwar.io/play/ and selects its interface language separately.
- There is no paywalled, gated, or login-only content behind the pages listed above.
- When quoting mechanics, prefer the FAQ section on the home page; when quoting availability, check the home page, since alpha builds change.
